podcast.title: Doctor Who Themed Hit
podcast.body: The Timelords released a Doctor Who themed hit that notably utilized the Gary Glitter song "Rock and Roll Part 2." "They resurfaced under the name of the Timelords, who released a Doctor Who themed hit that made the use of the Gary Glitter song Rock and Roll Part 2."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Copyright Liberation Front Philosophy
xref.body: The KLF, also known as "The Timelords" for specific projects, adopted the moniker "Copyright Liberation Front," reflecting their stance on sampling and copyright, which sometimes led to issues with the availability of their music. "After all, KLF stands for Copyright Liberation Front."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Transformation into The Timelords and KLF
xref.body: After The Jams, they resurfaced as The Timelords, releasing a Doctor Who-themed hit that sampled Gary Glitter's "Rock and Roll Part 2," and subsequently morphed into The KLF. "They resurfaced under the name of the Timelords, who released a Doctor Who themed hit that made the use of the Gary Glitter song Rock and Roll Part 2, and from there they morphed into the KLF."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
